# Widget `chart` — Chart

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use when the material gives numbers to compare (bar) or a trend over time or a variable (line).

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "chart",
  "title": "Chart",
  "props": {
    "type": "bar",
    "title": "Population by continent (billions)",
    "yLabel": "Billions",
    "labels": [
      "Asia",
      "Africa",
      "Europe"
    ],
    "series": [
      {
        "name": "2020",
        "values": [
          4.6,
          1.3,
          0.75
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"bar"` \| `"line"` | yes |
| `title` | string | no |
| `xLabel` | string | no |
| `yLabel` | string | no |
| `labels` | array of string (2–24) | yes |
| `series` | array of object (1–4) | yes |
| `series[].name` | string | yes |
| `series[].values` | array of number | yes |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
